topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for policies, rights, protected resource scopes, assurance requirements and authorization decisions.

semantics.identity_rule: Policy, right, resource, subject/session, decision and execution identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: edit-policy/test-decision/apply-policy operations invoke separate authorized workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing or testing policy grants no protected-resource authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Policy→right→resource→decision edges correspond only to explicit refs.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.
